value.rationale: Odd-prime integral torsion is mathematically invisible to rational path-Betti calculations and qualitatively distinct from previously existing two-primary regular circulant examples. A uniform infinite family of strongly connected vertex-transitive graphs and a step-deletion-minimal relation configuration provide a natural structural witness. The result is not presented as a globally minimal connection set or as a higher-dimensional classification.
